generatedBy: hand-authored starting values; retune against the human ground-truth set before marking any threshold Measured
contract: The tunable thresholds the three fun-proxy metrics read. Counts, never quotients: every rate a proxy reports is passes / n derived at read time, per docs/03 Part 5. These values are premises about people and ship as unmeasured until a calibration test cites a path:line that moved them. Anything here is data, not code (CLAUDE.md invariant 7); no DECISIONS.md number is owed for editing a value.

meaningfulChoice.verdict: paired-t CI on ΔTTD (seconds), computed with the choice removed vs present, common random numbers
meaningfulChoice.comment: A choice counts as meaningful on a replication set when its CI excludes zero. No single-seed verdict.

tensionBand.comment: Swing is the interquartile range of queueLengthSeries samples over the report window. Runaway = trend slope above runawaySlopePerMin at the horizon AND awtIsValid false. Band edges are the premise most in need of human calibration.

masterySlope.verdict: linearTrend of verdict-pass indicator over attempt index
masterySlope.comment: Run on holdout seeds so a positive slope means skill generalizes, not that a trace was memorized. Flat slope with reported comprehension gain is a scoring defect, not a player defect.

stage-1-first-call.comment: Two cars, low demand: a smaller building swings less, so its in-band window sits lower. Starting guess, uncalibrated.
